title: Medicare: Other Insurance Questions
about: The questions Medicare asks providers to use to find out whether another payer pays before Medicare (the model questions in the Medicare Secondary Payer Manual, chapter 3, section 20.2.1, a U.S. government work, in plainer words). Ask at the first visit; after that, ask whether anything has changed. The patient need not sign. Keep the answers 10 years. Medicare Advantage members are exempt.

source.name: Medicare Secondary Payer Manual (Pub. 100-05), chapter 3, section 20.2.1: model questions

blocks.text: Medicare asks us to find out whether any other insurance should pay for your care before Medicare does. Please answer each question.
Part 1. Injuries, accidents and black lung

blocks.label: Please check one answer for each.
items: Do you get benefits under the Black Lung Benefits Act?
Is your illness or injury from an accident or condition at work?
Is this care for an injury covered by no-fault, car or medical payment insurance?
Is this care for an injury or illness that someone else may be responsible for?

blocks.label: For each yes: the details
columns: Insurance company or employer, and address
Date it began or date of injury

blocks.text: Part 2. Medicare and work health insurance

blocks.label: I have Medicare because of (tick all that apply)
Please check one answer.
items: Do you have health insurance through a job that you, your spouse or another family member has now?

blocks.label: If yes: how many people work for that employer? (tick one)
If yes: the work health insurance
columns: Policy holder, and relationship to you

blocks.text: Part 3. Only if you have Medicare because of kidney failure

blocks.label: Please check one answer for each.
items: Do you have health insurance through a job, your own or a spouse's or family member's?
Have you had a kidney transplant?
Did you have that work health insurance before and on the day your Medicare began?

blocks.text: If kidney failure applies, check whether the patient is in the 30-month coordination period. Keep these answers for 10 years after the date of service.
